articles.title: Saudi Arabia joins condemnation of Iranian attacks on Bahrain
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia expressed its "fully solidarity" by condemning the Iranian attack on Bahrain. The Saudi Foreign Ministry called for an "immediate cessation of the blatant Iranian attacks on the countries of the region." Riyadh also called the "Iranian attacks constitute a violation of international law and the principles of good neighbourliness." The Gulf Kingdom's statement echoes similar statements of condemnation made by Egypt and Jordan on the Iranian strikes on Bahrain.

articles.title: Jordan condemns Iranian drone strike on Bahrain
articles.summary: Jordan joined other regional partners in condemning Iran's targeting of Bahrain as the clock ticks on whether the war will continue between Iran, the United States and Israel. A Jordanian Foreign Minsitry spokesperson condemned the "dangerous escalation and a blatant breach of international law." "Iran's brutal attacks on the sister kingdom of Bahrain as a flagrant violation of its sovereignty, a threat to its security, stability and territorial integrity," said the spokesperson.

articles.title: Iran claims attack on US military airbase in Bahrain
articles.summary: Iranian military confirmed on Sunday an attack on a US military base in Bahrain, in its second targeting the Middle Eastern country in the space of three days. Bahrain's military said it had intercepted several Iranian attacks, with the foreign ministry confirming its air defence systems had shot down Iranian drones, preventing them from reaching their intended targets.
